title: The Soulcialites
tagline: Supergluing fragmentations across DAOs thru the Good Governance Protocol
description: We've built a new DAO governance protocol - the Good Governance Protocol. The protocol enables users to connect their wallets to the website. The website hosts a dashboard where users can see their membership in different DAOs and their membership in different guilds within those DAOs. The Protocol utilizes SBTs to gate users' memberships and enable the tracking of experience across all their memberships. Composable split payments ensure the guilds receive continuous funding; this gives the DAO control of the guilds while also preserving guild discretion.
how_its_made: We deployed wrapped ERC 721s on Optimism. These tokens are soulbound tokens, with their transferability removed upon initial transfer. We built composable split payments on Superfluid. These payments are signed We used the Rainbow Kit to integrate WalletConnect into the website.
